title: What is Deep Research?

body.text: automatically searching and synthesizing hundreds of sources
— instead of Googling one query at a time, one command gives you a complete report with sources.

example: "Do Deep Research on EV market trends in ASEAN for 2025–2030 and summarize it as a report"

title: Deep Research vs normal search

body.text: Normal search gives a list of websites, but Deep Research
reads, analyzes, and synthesizes the information for you
— saving hours, great for research, reports, or decisions that need complete information.

example: "Research and compare the 5 most popular Python frameworks for data science in 2025"
